in_marathi.name: Anulata
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desire, attraction, love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anulata हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anulata means 'desire' or 'attraction'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'anu' which means 'towards' and 'lata' which means 'that which is drawn towards'. In Hindu mythology, Anulata represents the deep-rooted emotions and longings of the heart.
